name: safety-moderation-benchmark
description:
Safety Moderation Benchmark
	



	
		
		Overview
	

A comprehensive benchmark for training binary safety classifiers to detect harmful content across 9 safety-critical policy domains. The dataset combines 100% synthetic evaluation data with diverse real-world and synthetic training samples.
Total Size: 228,925 samples

Train: 191,186 (83.5%)
Validation: 33,739 (14.7%)  
Test: 4,000 (1.7% - 100% synthetic, stratified)
